annotations.title: What became of a receipt you recorded

description: What became of a receipt you recorded with `record_receipt`. We do not take a receipt on your word: each one is read against the payments WE read from the chain and judged `verified` (it paid the subject and the amount agrees), `contradicted` (which of the two did not), `not-found` (absent from what we read two days after it was filed, a statement about our reading and never that it did not happen) or `unverifiable` (the reference is not a transaction hash). Until judged it is `claimed`, and a claim raises no evidence status anywhere. Readable only by the key that wrote it. Free.
name: receipt_status

evidence.description: The common payment record (TODO-07): `state: built` with `facilitator` (who submitted, never credited), `onChainRecipient`, `listedPayee`, `facilitatorIsRecipient`, `recipientIsListedPayee`, `settlement`, `delivery`, `deliveryEvidence`, `says`; or `state: not-applicable` with `says` naming why no single payment is described.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

outcomeAt.description: When it was judged; null while it is still a claim.

reference.description: Your evidence, as you gave it.

says.description: What was found, or why it is still a claim.

status.description: What we found when we read it; `claimed` until then.

subject.description: The address it is about, read back.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.
